## What is infectious disease modelling?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- A model of how an infection spreads, and of how cases get reported
- Fitted to data that arrive late, incomplete and changing
- A question first. The question decides which data matter
- Fit, check, report with a date. Then again tomorrow
:::
